documents.bridge-report-en.md:
# Alder bridge trial
The Alder bridge carried 1200 kilograms in one static-load trial. This observation does not establish the maximum safe load.
Wind speed during that trial was 18 metres per second.
The observation period lasted three days. No flood-resistance test was performed.
The trial took place in May 2024.
documents.harbour-guide-en.md:
# West Pier beacon
The West Pier beacon stands on the western pier of Alder harbour.
Its tower is blue and its signal is six flashes per minute.
Mara Lyn is the current keeper. The beacon was commissioned in 1902.
The visitor room is closed every December; navigation continues.
documents.north-log-ru.md:
# Северный маяк
Северный маяк стоит на мысе Сосновый. Высота башни — 14 метров.
Башня жёлтая; её не следует путать с синей башней в гавани Олдер.
Северный маяк введён в строй в 1968 году. Имя смотрителя в журнале не указано.

The initial visitor-centre budget was 120 thousand euros in January 2024.
The approved replacement budget was 135 thousand euros in March 2024; it supersedes the January budget.
These are successive budgets, not competing current estimates.
